scope: correspondence-only test preparation; no staticness, camera, or DNF labels
history: twenty videos already evaluated for classical tracking; no learned-judge results used here; separate from all ten learned-judge development videos
selection: same fixed lags 5/15/30/60 and every first-visible track; all missing and borderline cases retained
label_policy: same reviewed annotations and native-pixel thresholds as development: close<=2, far>=8, occluded separate, intermediate unlabeled
prompt: Compare the marked detail in A with the candidate marked in B. The top row shows context; the bottom row shows native-pixel crops. Is the candidate close to the same detail, far from it, or is the original detail occluded? Reply with one label: close, far, occluded, or uncertain. Close means within 2 native pixels; far means at least 8 native pixels. Use uncertain when the images do not support a decision. Do not judge camera accuracy or whether the object is moving.
